body.name: Outer-set and set-of-sets Hausdorff radii
body.construction: When \(\mathcal H_n\ne\varnothing\), define \(r_n^{\mathrm{out}}=\sup_{A\in\mathcal H_n}d_H(C_n,A)\) and \(r_n^{\mathrm{set}}=\inf_{A\in\mathcal H_n}\sup_{B\in\mathcal H_n}d_H(A,B)\). Under the empty-intersection fallback, set \(r_n^{\mathrm{out}}=y_K-y_1\) and \(r_n^{\mathrm{set}}=(y_K-y_1)/2\).
